q2_gaps: a capitalized COMMON-noun label in premodifier position ('the old Watch ledgers') -- the Possession licence is stated only for a PROPER noun premodifying a common-noun head, while a capitalized common noun is a common noun by default when it is the referent's own label ('the Assembly'); the instruction set does not say whether such a bare capitalized premodifier mints a referent linked by Possession, or fuses as a compound kind (watch_ledger)
notes: Definite plural to a group witness, the descriptive age modifier distributed by the per-member copular rule at 1.0/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase (no quantifier word present), the stative-transitive subject as Agent, and the bare-plural kind-level object as a bare compound symbol with its head genus and unexposed noun modifier -- all as specified. Treating 'mention' as collective (group event, no per-member rule) is a judgment call the instruction set leaves to the distributive-vs-collective test, and the collective reading looks right here.
